verdict.rationale: Qdrant's docs claim built-in support for 'cloud-hosted embedding models directly with Qdrant' and configurable dense/sparse/multi-vector embeddings (qdrant-docs-9), suggesting some inference-at-ingest capability. However, a hands-on community report explicitly contradicts this, noting embeddings had to be generated client-side rather than in the DB, which 'felt somewhat besides the point' (qdrant-comm-8) — indicating the built-in embedding generation is either limited, add-on (e.g. FastEmbed/Inference API), or not as seamless as marketed. Missing for 10: first-party documentation walkthrough of configuring a model provider for automatic ingest+query-time embedding, and corroborating hands-on evidence that this actually works end-to-end without a separate pipeline.
